ARAVC_PAGE_LABEL_CONFIGURATION: ALSA RME ADI-2 Volume Control - Configuration
ARAVC_SWITCH_DOC_SERVICE_ACTIVE: Activate or deactivate the background service that controls the RME ADI-2 device outputs.
ARAVC_SELECT_DOC_DEVICE_NAME: Name (family) of the RME ADI-2 device. Select 'autodetect' to allow the background service to detect it automatically.
ARAVC_SELECT_DOC_CARD_NUMBER: ALSA card number of the RME ADI-2 device. Select 'autodetect' to allow the background service to detect it automatically
ARAVC_SWITCH_DOC_VERBOSE_LOG: Activate or deactivate verbose log for the background service.
ARAVC_SWITCH_DOC_LINE12_ACTIVE: Activate or deactive control of Line Output 1/2
ARAVC_SELECT_DOC_LINE12_MIN_DB: Minimum volume, in dB, on the RME ADI-2 device.
ARAVC_SELECT_DOC_LINE12_MAX_DB: Maximum volume, in dB, on the RME ADI-2 device.
ARAVC_SWITCH_DOC_PHONES34_ACTIVE: Activate or deactive control of Phones Output 3/4
ARAVC_SELECT_DOC_PHONES34_MIN_DB: Minimum volume, in dB, on the RME ADI-2 device.
ARAVC_SELECT_DOC_PHONES34_MAX_DB: Maximum volume, in dB, on the RME ADI-2 device.
